div.head: Af 3
div.ab: IIII. Gif hwa cyninges borg abrece, gebete þone tyht swa him ryht wisie, ⁊ þæs borges bryce mid V pundum mærra pæninga. Ærcebiscepes borges bryce oððe his mundbyrd gebete mid ðrim pundum. Oðres biscepes oððe ealdormonnes borges bryce oððe mundbyrd gebete mid twam pundum.

IIII. Gif hwa cyninges borh abrece, gebete þone tihtlan swa him riht wisie, ⁊ þæs borges bryce mid V pundum mærra peninga. Ercebiscopes borges bryce oððe his mundbyrd gebete mid III pundum. Oðres biscopes oððe ealdermannes borges brice oððe his mundbyrd gebete mid twam pundum.
… … … … . Oþres bisceopes oððe ealdormannes borges bryce oððe mundbyrd gebete mid II pundum.

Si quis plegium regis infringat, emendet inculpationem sicut rectum sit, et infracturam plegii quinque libris merorum denariorum. Archiepiscopi borhbrece siue mundbird emendetur tribus libris, aliorum episcoporum uel aldermannorum (comitum) emendetur II libris.

Gif hwa cyninges borg abrece, gebete þone tyht swa him ryht wisie ⁊ þæs borges bryce mid V pundum mærra pæninga. Ærcebiscepes borges bryce oððe his mundbyrd gebete mid ðrim pundum. Oðres biscepes oððe ealdormonnes borges bryce oððe mundbyrd gebete mid twam pundum.

{IIII} Gif hwa cyninges borg abrece, gebete þone tyht swa him ryht wisie, ⁊ þæs borges bryce mid V pundum mærra pæninga. Ærcebiscepes borges bryce oððe his mundbyrd gebete mid ðrim pundum. Oðres biscepes oððe ealdormonnes borges bryce oððe mundbyrd gebete mid twam pundum.

Wenn jemand die vom König [gewährte] Bürgschaft verletzt, so büsse er die Inzicht [dem Kläger], wie ihm das Gericht zuerkennt, und die Verletzung jenes Bürgschaftsschutzes mit 5 Pfund Pfennigen reinen [Silbers dem Könige]. Die Verletzung einer vom Erzbischof [gewährten] Bürgschaft oder dessen Schutzgewalt büsse man [diesem] mit 3 Pfund. Die Verletzung einer von einem anderen Bischofe oder einem Ealdorman [gewährten] Bürgschaft oder [dessen] Schutzgewalt büsse man [ihm] mit 2 Pfund.

If someone violates the surety [granted] by the king, let him compensate for the charge [to the plaintiff] as the court awards him, and for the violation of that surety-protection with 5 pounds of pennies of pure [silver, to the king]. The violation of a surety [granted] by the archbishop, or of his protective authority, is to be compensated [to him] with 3 pounds. The violation of a surety [granted] by another bishop or by an ealdorman, or of [his] protective authority, is to be compensated [to him] with 2 pounds.

If anyone violates the king's protection, he shall pay compensation for the crime [to the injured person], as the law directs him, and 5 pounds of pure silver pennies for violation of the king's protection; for violation of the archbishop’s protection or guardianship 3 pounds must be paid as compensation; for violation of the protection or the guardianship of any other bishop or of an ealdorman 2 pounds must be paid as compensation.

If anyone violates the king’s surety, he is to pay compensation for the charge as the law directs him, and for the breach of the surety with five pounds of pure pennies. The breach of the archbishop’s surety or of his protection is to be compensated with three pounds; the breach of the surety or protection of another bishop or an ealdorman is to be compensated with two pounds.

If someone breaches the king’s security, let him compensate for that offense as law indicates, and for the breach of that security with 5 pounds of greater pennies. Let him compensate breaching an archbishop’s security or violation of his mund with three pounds. Let him compensate breaching the security of a bishop [of other rank] or an ealdorman, or the violation of [their] mund with two pounds.

Nicht ‘Untreue des Bürgen gegen seine Verpflichtung’ Schmid 540b; vielmehr Schutz; s. d. Gl. Nur ein Fall von Schutzbruch ist, dass eine Partei Verbürgung eines Vertrages durch einen Hochstehenden erbat und den Vertrag bricht; wenn z. B. der Brautvormund Trauung versprochen hat, aber unterlässt, büsst er (nicht bloss dem Bräutigam, sondern auch) den Bürgschaftsbruch dem Verlobungsbürgen; Ine 31. Mit borg synonym steht mund. Denn Cnut II 58 lässt, Af ausschreibend, oððe mundbyrd hinter borges bryce in Af 3 fort; Q übersetzt dies ‘oder’ durch siue; für borg setzt mundbryce ein Grið 11 und ‘Königsschutz’ (s. d. Gl 5) kostet ebenfalls 5 £

Not ‘breach of faith by the surety towards his obligation’, Schmid 540b; rather protection; see that word in Gl. It is only one case of breach of protection when a party has requested a guarantee of a contract by a person of high rank and then breaks the contract; if, e.g., the bride’s guardian has promised the marriage but fails to carry it out, he pays compensation for the breach of surety (not only to the bridegroom but also) to the surety of the betrothal; Ine 31. mund stands as a synonym of borg. For Cnut II 58, copying Af, omits oððe mundbyrd after borges bryce in Af 3; Q translates this ‘or’ by siue; Grið 11 substitutes mundbryce for borg, and ‘king’s protection’ (see that word in Gl 5) likewise costs 5 £
Der Anspruch des Klägers geht neben dem des Schutzherrn her
The plaintiff’s claim runs alongside that of the protector

Ein Abschreiber von Q begeht die häufige Verwechselung von borg mit burg (s. o. Af Rb 3¹), ein anderer lässt nach Französ. Art das interkonsonantische d aus mund fort
A copyist of Q makes the frequent confusion of borg with burg (see above Af Rb 3¹); another, in the French manner, omits the interconsonantal d from mund

i.e. commits an offence against any person (or place?) under the special protection of the king. The word borg seems to be used not, as usually, in the sense of bail, but as more or less equivalent to mund. Cf. Be Griðe, cap. 11, and the note to Abt. cap. 8.
Anglo-Saxon coins are seldom debased, but it is worth noting that the most debased are those of the Mercian king Burgred (852—874), who was still reigning when Alfred came to the throne.
